answer.reason: The site's main navigation menu is driven by the Header content item's "Navigation" field, which is a nested linked-content grid of TopLevelNav items. Each TopLevelNav item represents one top-level entry in the main nav (with a required Link field and optional Sub Nav Links). Adding 'Docs' as a new top-level menu item means creating a new TopLevelNav content item (with its Link pointing to the docs page) and adding it to the Header's Navigation list — not a new page model or a different content type like NavLink (which is used only for sub-nav items) or Footer/FooterLink (which govern the footer, not main nav).
